final: SELECT a.translink AS translink, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr >= 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
